The CreateGameController class handles the logic and UI interactions for creating a new game within the GUI application.

  • Method Details

    • init

      public void init()
      Initializes the CreateGameController, Specifically: - Populates the color combo box with all available PlayerColor values. - Sets the level combo box with predefined levels (0 and 2). - Configures the lobby size combo box with predefined sizes (2, 3, and 4).

    • parseNickname

      private String parseNickname(String nickname)
      Parses and formats the provided nickname by removing any leading or trailing whitespace and excess internal spacing.

    • onSubmitGameConfigButtonClick

      public void onSubmitGameConfigButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent actionEvent)
      Handles the action triggered by clicking the "SubmitGameConfig" button. Validates the inputs provided for nickname, player color, game level, and lobby size. If validation passes, a new game is created with the specified configuration.
      Parameters:
      actionEvent - The action event triggered by the button click.
